title: Decoding the Underlying Meaning of Multimodal Hateful Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated explanations for misogynistic and sex-targeted hateful memes using human evaluations (fluency and relevance) and automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, BERTScore), including a specific domain adaptation evaluation on the unseen MAMI (Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification) dataset.

Evaluating model-generated natural language explanations for multimodal hateful memes targeting race by assessing the outputs against ground-truth annotated reasons using automated metrics and human evaluations.

Evaluating model-generated natural language explanations for multimodal hateful memes targeting religion by assessing the outputs against ground-truth annotated reasons using automated metrics and human evaluations.

Evaluating model-generated natural language explanations for multimodal hateful memes targeting nationalities by assessing the outputs against ground-truth annotated reasons using automated metrics and human evaluations.

Evaluating model-generated natural language explanations for multimodal hateful memes targeting disabled individuals by assessing the outputs against ground-truth annotated reasons using automated metrics and human evaluations.

Evaluating model-generated explanations for hateful memes targeting the LGBTQ+ community (categorized under 'Sex' targets in the dataset) by comparing outputs to ground-truth reasons using automated metrics and human evaluations.
